resources.string: The server rejected this username or password (HTTP 401).
The server refused access (HTTP 403). Check whether the account is active, expired or blocked. This response alone does not mean the server address is wrong.
The server is temporarily unavailable (HTTP 5xx). Try again later.
This IPTV account is blocked on the M81 server (HTTP 403). Contact the account administrator.
This IPTV subscription has expired on the M81 server (HTTP 403). Check the account expiry date.
This IPTV account is not active on the M81 server (HTTP 403). Check the account status.
